flyers.title: LuvUrCity Insurance & Benefits Services
flyers.alt: LuvUrCity flyer: Chasity Chapel, licensed insurance agent. Experience, knowledge, trust. Services include health, dental and vision, life, short and long-term disability, group insurance, employee benefits, critical care and hospital indemnity, long-term care, annuities and retirement, final expense, plus small-business consulting. Call or text 872-777-7991.

flyers.title: Cash Benefits for 1099 Workers
flyers.alt: Flyer for entrepreneurs, independent contractors and 1099 workers: if you were sick or injured and cannot work, would you still receive a paycheck? Cash benefits paid directly to you through disability, sickness and accident plans. Individual or group plans available. Contact Chasity Chapel, benefits coordinator, at 872-777-7991.

flyers.title: Your Health. Your Family. Our Mission.
flyers.alt: Flyer: Your health, your family, our mission. Chasity Chapel helps individuals, families and businesses with health, senior benefits, life, dental, vision, short-term disability, critical care, hospital indemnity and group insurance. Call 872-777-7991.

flyers.title: Final Expense & Life Insurance
flyers.alt: Flyer: Licensed insurance advisor offering free consultations. Final expense coverage, whole life and term policies, living benefits, and health, dental and vision. Contact Chasity D. Chapel.

flyers.title: Affordable Health Insurance
flyers.alt: Flyer: Protect what matters most with affordable health insurance for you and your family. Comprehensive coverage, preventive care, and plans for self-employed people or anyone changing jobs. Speak directly with a live agent.
